                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n293:T60a,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Cost price (CP) of the fan = Rs. x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          List price (LP) = CP + 22% of CP = 1.22 × CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Discount offered = 15% of LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Profit earned = Rs. 111

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Selling price (SP) = LP - Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Discount = 15% of LP = 0.15 × LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Profit = SP - CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Let the cost price be Rs. x.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          List price (LP) = 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Discount = 0.15 × 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Selling price (SP) = LP - Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x - 0.15 × 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x (1 - 0.15)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x × 0.85

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.037 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given profit = Rs. 111

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Profit = SP - CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 111 = 1.037 × x - x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 111 = 0.037 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 111 / 0.037

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x ≈ 3000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          List Price (LP) = 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          LP = 1.22 × 3000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          LP = 3660

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Cost price (CP) of the fan = Rs. x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          List price (LP) = CP + 22% of CP = 1.22 × CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Discount offered = 15% of LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Profit earned = Rs. 111

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Selling price (SP) = LP - Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Discount = 15% of LP = 0.15 × LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Profit = SP - CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Let the cost price be Rs. x.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          List price (LP) = 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Discount = 0.15 × 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Selling price (SP) = LP - Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x - 0.15 × 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x (1 - 0.15)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x × 0.85

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.037 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given profit = Rs. 111

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Profit = SP - CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 111 = 1.037 × x - x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 111 = 0.037 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 111 / 0.037

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x ≈ 3000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          List Price (LP) = 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          LP = 1.22 × 3000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          LP = 3660

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The list price of the fan is Rs. 3660.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          पंखे का क्रय मूल्य (CP) = x रुपये 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          अंकित मूल्य (LP) = CP + CP का 22% = 1.22 × CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दी गई छूट = LP का 15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          लाभ अर्जित = 111 रुपये 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = LP - छूट

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          छूट = LP का 15% = 0.15 × LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          लाभ = SP - CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          मान लीजिए क्रय मूल्य x रुपये है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          अंकित मूल्य (LP) = 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          छूट = 0.15 × 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = LP - छूट

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x - 0.15 × 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x (1 - 0.15)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.22 × x × 0.85

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SP = 1.037 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया लाभ = रु. 111

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          लाभ = SP - CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 111 = 1.037 × x - x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 111 = 0.037 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 111 / 0.037

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x ≈ 3000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          अंकित मूल्य (LP) = 1.22 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          LP = 1.22 × 3000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          LP = 3660

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          पंखे का अंकित मूल्य 3660 रुपये है।
